Lemma
[Pointwise subconvergence to a flat cylinder] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0084 ↗ lem:chow-iv-conformal-factor-derivatives 1. ch28:28.54\group Finite Width

Translations of the cylindrical end subconverge in every $C^k$ norm on compact sets to a static flat cylinder; the limiting conformal factor is constant.
